0022600225.text: The Houston Rockets host the Golden State Warriors in their 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams at 8-3 through 11 games. Houston is 5-1 at home and sits 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 6th in the West, while Golden State is 4th in the West, 1.5 games back in the Pacific, on an eight-game winning streak with an 8-2 record over its last ten. The Rockets are without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and the Warriors are without Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 regular-season win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
